title: NDJSON runtime architecture

modules.server.cjs: HTTP server (node:http, no framework); health/stats/search/browse/mcq/mcqs/random/subjects/chapters/topics/categories/exams/quizzes/mocktests/pastpapers/bookmarks/history/leaderboard/analytics/export/kg/*; NOT_MIGRATED 501 with data_source:'sqlite_disabled'; SQLITE_DISABLED env gate
modules.query-engine.cjs: parity engine: ordering (created_at DESC, id ASC), options attachment, relatedQuestions tag scoring, search postings, random sampling, meta lookup (id -> subjectIdx int)
modules.data-loader.cjs: streaming gzip line reader (StringDecoder-based, multi-byte safe), bounded caches (LRU subject parts 20 entries/30000 rows, search buckets 32MB, key-index files, manifest/meta/recent), loadSubjectOptions
modules.kg-store.cjs: streaming NDJSON.GZ store for 18 KG tables; caches tables <= 120000 rows; mcq_concepts mapped once (~30MB)
modules.kg-query.cjs: KG query layer (stats, concept search/detail, relations, prerequisites, objectives, micro, exams, distractors, learning paths)
modules.user-store.cjs: server-side JSON persistence for user features (userdata/*.json)

data_layout.database/data: 643MB exports: mcqs/<subject>/part01.ndjson.gz (244 subjects), kg/* (18 files, 2.9MB), concepts/, assessment/, chapters/, topics/, subtopics/, subjects/
data_layout.runtime-v2/indexes: 632.7MB: mcq_by_id.json 20MB, recent.json 23MB, search/ 37 buckets, options/ 243 subject files, chapter|topic|difficulty|year|exam/<key>.json, manifest.json, mcq_by_subject.json, qhash.idx 75MB + concept.idx (pass5 outputs, currently unread)
data_layout.source_of_truth: SQLite database is the master; exports are re-generated by database/scripts/export-db.js and are currently fresh (see phase38_integrity.json)

startup.note: cold start streams exports lazily; heavy structures (meta, recent, search buckets) load on first use

sqlite_usage: none in the read path; db/pakistan-mcqs.sqlite is read only by database/scripts/export-db.js (re-export) — never modified
